questions.stem_text:
Which of the following quotations best describes the central thesis of difference
feminism?

options.A: There are fundamental differences between individual women.'
options.B: Men and women have different conceptions of the feminist project.'
options.C: Women look to context, whereas men appeal to neutral, abstract notions of justice.'
options.D: Men are unable to comprehend their differences from women.'

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Women look to context, whereas men appeal to neutral, abstract notions of justice.'

questions.stem_text: What does the principle 'pacta sunt servanda' mean?

options.A: Parties to a treaty should be cognizant of its terms and not misinterpret them
options.B: Parties to a treaty should safeguard the object and purpose of the treaty
options.C: Parties to a treaty should adhere to its terms in good faith
options.D: Parties to a treaty should not violate the most important provisions of the treaty

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Parties to a treaty should adhere to its terms in good faith

questions.stem_text:
Cicero's conception of natural law is 'based on the idea that 'true law is right reason in
agreement with Nature.' Reason is a key element because:

options.A: It is a sin for humans not to apply reason.
options.B: The principles of natural law are discoverable by reason.
options.C: Natural law does not apply without good reason.
options.D: The law of nature is the basis of all positive law.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The principles of natural law are discoverable by reason.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following articles are not qualified rights?
Should treaties assume a particular form?

options.A: Treaties should always be designated as such and assume a particular form
options.B: Treaties should always assume a particular form, no matter how they are designated
options.C: Treaties do not have to assume a particular form or designated as such
options.D: Treaties have to be designated as such, no matter what form they assume

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Treaties do not have to assume a particular form or designated as such
